∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) [inst : CommRing.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Ring.{u_2} A] [inst_2 : Algebra.{u_1, u_2} k A]
  (I : TwoSidedIdeal.{u_2} A) (a b : A),
  Iff
    (Eq.{u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (Etingof.quotientAlgHom.{u_1, u_2} k A I) a)
      (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (Etingof.quotientAlgHom.{u_1, u_2} k A I) b))
    (Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} I (HSub.hSub.{u_2, u_2, u_2} a b))
